messages:
Leo (Customer Success): FYI we've got an urgent from AcmeFinance — they can't access their audit logs in Console or via API. Getting 403 with a body that says 'insufficient_entitlement'. Customer claims contract specifies 90-day retention but Console only shows 30 days. ticket SUP-98321 created.

Acme Admin (Customer): hitting "View audit logs" yields an error popup: 'You do not have permission to view audit logs.' Tried our org owner account (SSO via Okta) and still 403. API test returns: 403 + {
  "error": "insufficient_entitlement",
  "reason": "audit_log_read_not_enabled_for_org"
}. They need immediate access for compliance audit tomorrow.

Maya (Support): Sorry about the hit — taking this now. Can you paste the exact curl you used and the response headers (x-request-id / x-correlation-id)? Also which Okta group maps to the Redwood role for audit access?

Acme Admin (Customer): here's the curl we used:
```
curl -i -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" \n  "https://api.redwood.ai/v1/audit/logs?org=acmefinance&start=2024-10-01&end=2024-11-01"
```
Response headers: x-request-id: rwd-4f9a7c, x-correlation-id: 09b2c5e7. Full body same as above. Okta group is `ACME_RWD_ADMINS` which maps to `org_admin` role.

Maya (Support): thanks. Assigning to Eng-Security and SRE. I've added the support ticket and flagged as P0 because of compliance deadline.

Arjun (Eng-Security): pinging in. Quick checks: 1) entitlement flag for audit_read might not be set on the org record; 2) token scopes might be missing `audit:read`; 3) role mapping for SSO might not include the `audit_viewer` entitlement. I can check the org row. @Grace can you confirm infra/retention job status?

Grace (SRE): no infra incidents in the last 24h. Retention background job for log purge ran on schedule; nothing abnormal. But retention windows are controlled by the org entitlement field `audit_log_retention_days`. If that's set to 30 we'll show 30 regardless of contract.

Arjun (Eng-Security): can you dump the org document for acmefinance? I'll redact keys but need the entitlements and plan fields. Maya, either add me to the support ticket or paste the org id.

Maya (Support): org id: org_0a3b4c. Pasting minimal org record from internal read-only query: 
```
{
  "org_id": "org_0a3b4c",
  "plan": "enterprise_v2",
  "entitlements": ["api_access","embed:read"],
  "audit_log_retention_days": 30
}
```

Arjun (Eng-Security): aha — no `audit_log_read` entitlement and retention explicitly 30. That explains the 403 and the UI showing 30d. Do we have a contract ingestion bug? Priya from Product/Account, can you confirm what the contract says for AcmeFinance?

Priya (Product): I checked the commercial system: AcmeFinance has an amendment (AM-318) that added +60 days for audit retention (90 total). It looks like the billing/entitlement sync job failed for that amendment on 2024-11-02 — there was a transient DB timeout and the job did not retry. Filed internal sync ticket INT-5434.

Maya (Support): ok plan — I'll request an emergency entitlement flip for the customer and escalate to legal/accounting for manual confirmation. Customer needs read access ASAP.

Acme Admin (Customer): can you do that now? Our auditors are waiting.

Arjun (Eng-Security): I can patch the org entitlements temporarily — I'll add `audit_log_read` and bump `audit_log_retention_days` to 90. Note: changing retention backward/forward needs a background migration for older logs. We can set flag to prevent purges while we backfill.

audit-bot: Automation: entitlement-change request queued (req-7119).

Grace (SRE): Before we backfill, I suggest we:
- set `no_purge` label on org_0a3b4c
- set retention to 90
- add entitlement `audit_log_read`
Then run backfill job to restore older logs from cold storage; estimate ~2 hours for 30 days backfill.

Maya (Support): timeline communicated to customer: we'll grant immediate read access, then restore missing historical logs within ~2-3 hours. Keeping them posted.

Arjun (Eng-Security): making change now. Command run (internal):
```
UPDATE orgs SET entitlements = array_append(entitlements, 'audit_log_read'), audit_log_retention_days = 90 WHERE org_id = 'org_0a3b4c';
-- set no_purge flag
INSERT INTO org_flags (org_id, flag) VALUES ('org_0a3b4c','no_purge');
```
Changed at 2024-11-12T16:12:34Z.

Maya (Support): patched and validated: Acme Admin can now hit Console and API and gets 200 with logs. Sample API response header: `x-request-id: rwd-aa22c`, body includes events.

Acme Admin (Customer): I see logs now, thanks. The UI still shows 30d in one place — might be cached.

Grace (SRE): kicked off backfill job. Job ID BF-2024-11-12-77. ETA 2h for the 60d restore from cold. We'll keep the `no_purge` flag until backfill completes.

Priya (Product): filing follow-up to fix the sync job and add an alert when entitlement sync fails. Also logging a product requirement to surface contract vs actual retention in Console for org admins (so customers and CS can see mismatches).

Maya (Support): final status update to customer in ticket: entitlement added, retention set to 90, backfill started, ETA 2h. Created internal follow-ups: INT-5434 (sync job retry fix), PROD-2241 (console visibility), SRE-9012 (backfill monitor).

Acme Admin (Customer): Appreciate the quick turnaround. Please send confirmation when all 90 days are visible in UI.

Arjun (Eng-Security): Backfill completed at 2024-11-12T18:24:01Z. Verified event counts for Oct and Sep present. Removed `no_purge` flag after verification.

Maya (Support): marking SUP-98321 resolved. Summary: root cause — entitlement sync job missed AM-318 amendment; symptom — 403 + 30d retention; remediation — entitlement patch + backfill; follow-ups created for automation and product improvements.

Priya (Product): we'll also coordinate with account/legal to retroactively confirm the remediation and confirm any compliance notes needed for audit trail.

Leo (Customer Success): Thanks team — closing out after Acme signs off. :white_check_mark:
